answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in sonnet, checked in ferrous, and trellis makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 12 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
